text:
Hi everyone,

I urgently need help with Turkish documents for an Israeli B1 partner visa.

I live in Switzerland and I still have both Swiss and Turkish citizenship. My partner is Israeli. We need two Turkish documents with apostille:

* Nüfus Kayıt Örneği (Population Registration Certificate)
* Criminal Record Certificate (Sabıka Kaydı)

The documents can be in Turkish or English, but they need to be officially issued and apostilled.

The problem is that I cannot travel to Turkey due to lack of time, and I do not have anyone in Turkey who can help me. I tried to use the official Turkish e-Apostille website (e-apostil.gov.tr), but the payment has not worked for almost 4 weeks.

I tried several Visa and Mastercard cards, but the payment always gets stuck at the 3-D Secure verification step. I contacted both the e-Apostille support and my card providers. The e-Apostille team says everything works on their side and suggested using a Turkish bank card, but I do not have one.

Does anyone know a reliable person, lawyer, company, or service in Switzerland, Israel, or Turkey that can help me obtain these documents and arrange the apostille without me travelling to Turkey?

I am really in urgent need because of our visa process. Any personal experience or recommendation would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you very much!
